name: Apple Intelligence Enabler
tagline: 为 iOS 18.1–18.x 提供 Apple 智能相关配置与安全恢复工具。
description: Apple 智能启用器默认使用 iPhone 15 Pro 配置，帮助受支持的 iOS 18.x 系统准备 Apple 智能相关能力。
美版地区配置可独立启用和恢复；模型下载完成后，可尝试恢复真实机型并保留 AI 能力。
分项备份与恢复只处理本插件负责的配置，并与 FaceTime Audio Enabler 1.0.6 保持兼容。
notice: ⚠️ 应用配置后请自行完整重启，并等待模型下载完成后再恢复真实机型。机型伪装可能影响 Face ID；恢复后的 Face ID 和 AI 持续可用性仍需实测。测试环境中请停用 Immortalizer 2.0.1.1 注入，否则唤起原生 Siri 可能进入安全模式。
features: 默认使用 iPhone 15 Pro 的 Apple 智能兼容配置
独立启用或恢复 US / LL/A 美版地区配置
恢复真实机型并保留当前 AI 能力
分项备份、冲突处理及 FaceTime Audio Enabler 1.0.6 共存
简体中文、繁体中文和英文设置界面
usage: 安装后进入“设置 → Apple 智能启用器”应用所需配置
由你自行完整重启手机，并按系统提示等待模型下载完成
确认 Siri 可用后，再按需执行“恢复真实机型，保留 AI”

changes: 新增 iOS 18.1–18.x Apple 智能配置，默认使用 iPhone 15 Pro 兼容配置。
新增独立 US / LL/A 地区配置与“恢复真实机型，保留 AI”操作。
新增分项备份与恢复、三语言设置及 Rootless / RootHide 支持，并兼容 FaceTime Audio Enabler 1.0.6。

en.name: Apple Intelligence Enabler
en.tagline: Apple Intelligence configuration and safe restoration tools for iOS 18.1–18.x.
description: Apple Intelligence Enabler uses an iPhone 15 Pro profile by default to prepare related capabilities on supported iOS 18.x systems.
U.S. region settings can be enabled and restored independently. After model downloads finish, the real device model can be restored while retaining the AI capability.
Per-setting backup and restoration only manage this tweak's configuration and remain compatible with FaceTime Audio Enabler 1.0.6.
en.notice: ⚠️ Fully reboot the device yourself after applying the configuration, and wait for model downloads to finish before restoring the real model. Model spoofing may affect Face ID; continued Face ID and AI availability after restoration still require device testing. Disable Immortalizer 2.0.1.1 injection in the tested environment, or invoking native Siri may enter Safe Mode.
features: iPhone 15 Pro Apple Intelligence compatibility profile by default
Independent enable and restore controls for the US / LL/A region profile
Restore the real device model while retaining the current AI capability
Per-setting backups, conflict handling, and coexistence with FaceTime Audio Enabler 1.0.6
Settings in English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese
usage: Install the package and apply the required configuration in Settings → Apple Intelligence Enabler
Fully reboot the device yourself and wait for the system to finish downloading its models
After confirming that Siri works, optionally use Restore Real Model, Keep AI

changes: Added Apple Intelligence configuration for iOS 18.1–18.x, using an iPhone 15 Pro compatibility profile by default.
Added independent US / LL/A region configuration and a Restore Real Model, Keep AI option.
Added per-setting backup and restore, trilingual settings, Rootless and RootHide support, and compatibility with FaceTime Audio Enabler 1.0.6.
